description: Enter bar and target weight to get exact plates per side and the correct loading order.

faqs.a: Greedy from the largest plate down: 25, 20, 15, 10, 5, 2.5, 1.25 kg per side.
Load the heaviest plates first (closest to the bar sleeve), then lighter ones outside them.
Standard Olympic bars are 20 kg (men's) or 15 kg (women's) — pick yours before calculating.
faqs.q: How much does the bar weigh?

faqs.a: If the remainder cannot be made with 1.25 kg plates, the tool tells you the closest achievable weight.
faqs.q: What if my target is not reachable?

howto: Select your bar weight (20 kg or 15 kg).
Load plates per side in the shown order, heaviest first.
title: Gym Plate Calculator
